license_scope.all_resources: original licenses retained; no blanket CC0/MIT requirement

composer_npm.method: exact existing installed public package bytes; official resolved/integrity values remain in unchanged npm lock; no install run

node.method: Existing verified byte copy independently matches official Node release SHA256 list; complete release LICENSE retained. No Node process started.

dark_runtime.method: reuse declared read-only pinned cache or stage exact files; no old business runtime-source

html_runtime.method: official per-package archive SHA/integrity and full per-file list; preserve actual notices

python_and_base_runtime.method: explicit existing audited public portable runtime/distribution files, fixed per-file SHA; preserve original package metadata and licenses; no blanket MIT/CC0 assertion

restoration.copy_policy: only listed sources/resources; never scan projects/private media; reuse equal SHA bytes or cache with explicit bindings; target source/fonts remain required

snapcn_npm.method: All original complete production npm package bodies supplied as SHA-pinned resources; no user npm/setup step.
snapcn_npm.license_policy: Preserve each original LICENSE/NOTICE. Paper Design packages carry PolyForm Shield terms; no blanket MIT assertion or relicensing.
